harness_zh: 城市智能体离线回放台架：6 个官方场景 × 8 项任务模板（48 任务）。所有记录均为固定数据，无随机性、无网络访问、无个人信息。
harness_en: Offline replay harness for the urban agent: six official scenarios by eight task templates (48 tasks). Every record is fixed data with no randomness, no network access and no personal information.
reproducibility_zh: 任何审阅者均可按 simulation.json 的 tasks 数组手动重算全部聚合值；公式写入 metrics.json 的 formula 字段。
reproducibility_en: Any reviewer can recompute every aggregate by hand from the tasks array; the formulas are written in the formula field of metrics.json.
scenario_registry_ref: proposal.md §6 13 张场景卡 + geometry/constraints.geojson SCN-01..18

tasks.task_zh: 通勤者在 SC-AI-01 站点选择上车点；系统应在 ≤ 5 秒内返回最优上车方案。
tasks.task_en: Commuter selects pickup at SC-AI-01; system must return optimal pickup plan in <= 5s.

tasks.task_zh: 开发者在 SC-AI-02 提交 demo；系统应自动生成多语言字幕文档。
tasks.task_en: Developer submits demo at SC-AI-02; system auto-generates multilingual subtitled doc.

tasks.task_zh: 老人在 SC-AI-04 完成支付；系统应提供大字版 + 语音播报 + 家属短信确认。
tasks.task_en: Senior completes payment at SC-AI-04; system provides large text + voice + family SMS.

tasks.task_zh: 企业在 SC-AI-06 提交数据目录；系统应做字段级脱敏。
tasks.task_en: Enterprise submits data directory at SC-AI-06; system does field-level pseudonymisation.

tasks.task_zh: 机器人在 SC-AI-07 配送；应避障 + 检测行人 1.5m 内缓停。
tasks.task_en: Robot delivers at SC-AI-07; obstacle avoidance + pedestrian 1.5m slow stop.

tasks.task_zh: 用户在 SC-AI-08 申请数据要素；系统应做登记 + 合规 + 5 年审计类保留。
tasks.task_en: User requests data element at SC-AI-08; system does registration + compliance + 5-year retention.

tasks.task_zh: 红队在 SC-AI-10 测试模型；治理委员会应在 ≤ 7s 内响应风险告警。
tasks.task_en: Red-team tests model at SC-AI-10; governance committee responds to risk alert in <= 7s.

tasks.task_zh: 老人拒绝 SC-AI-SEN AI 服务；系统应触发降级 + 全人工保留入口。
tasks.task_en: Senior refuses SC-AI-SEN AI service; system triggers downgrade + fully-manual fallback.

limitations_zh: 本 simulation.json 为离线概念性回放台架；不替代现场试点
任务数量 (48) 与完成率基于固定数据；不反映真实部署能力
performance / 时延数值为台架记录，不作为实施承诺
limitations_en: simulation.json is offline conceptual replay harness; does not substitute for field pilot
Task count (48) + completion rate based on fixed data; does not reflect real deployment capability
Performance / latency numbers are harness-recorded; not implementation commitments
